tasks.description: Correct diff-view structured message emission for a 2-file diff payload
tasks.prompt: You are using the lets-render-rich-response skill. A run step has produced a diff between two files: file_a.py (before) and file_a.py (after). The diff adds 3 lines and removes 1 line. Emit the correct RailMessage for a diff-view structured fast-path response. Include all required fields: kind, messageId, runId, episodeId, emittedAt, schemaId, schemaVersion, and a payload with files array containing both file entries with their hunks.

tasks.description: Correct generated tile spec with all required fields and declaredActions
tasks.prompt: You are using the lets-render-rich-response skill. Generate a GeneratedTileSpec for a comparison card that lets the operator pick between 'Approach A' and 'Approach B'. The tile must declare two actions (pick-a, pick-b), include a tileId, jsx using React.createElement only, a label, and an allowlist with at least one navigateRoutes entry. Show the complete JSON spec.

tasks.description: Correct fallback to kind:text when JSX fails validation
tasks.prompt: You are using the lets-render-rich-response skill. You attempted to generate JSX for a tile but the generated code contains eval('malicious'). The validator has rejected it. Show the correct fallback behavior: emit a RailTextMessage (kind: text) and emit a validation_failure audit record. Include runId, episodeId, tileId, reason, and timestamp in the audit record.
